title: Two ways to read a number
hints: For `parseStrict`, `std::from_chars` does most of the work. Its page tells you what it does **not** accept (a `+`) and what it does not check (that it used every character): handle those two yourself.
`readLeadingInt` is `std::stoi` with its `pos` argument, wrapped in `try`. The page lists exactly two exceptions; catch each and fill in the result the way this page asks.
